senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (abbrev. of Constantinopolis) Constantinople (Byzantium), the capital of the Lower Roman empire (frequ. identified with Rome-Edom).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 108:11">Targ. Ps. CVIII, 11</cite> <he>קושנ׳ דאדום</he> (read <he>קושטנ׳</he>; oth. ed. <he>קרתא</he>; ed. Wil. <he>אדום</he> only).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 4:21">Targ. Lam. IV, 21</cite> <he>קושט׳ קרתא דאדום</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>ברתא דאדום</he>; Var. <he>קרתא דמתבניא בארע ארמניאה</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 24:19">Targ. Y. I Num. XXIV, 19</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 24:24">24</cite> <he>קוס׳</he>.—
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX</cite> <he>קוסטאנטינוס בנה ק׳</he> Constantine built Constantinople; Yalk. ib. 642.
